influences.name: Supertramp
influences.context: In a way, I was imitating Supertramp: they were playing that kind of piano on 'Dreamer'. That influenced it, but 'Blinded by the Light' is a very good piano part; integral to the whole song.

influences.name: Paul Simon
influences.context: I did an African album before Paul Simon called Somewhere in Afrika in 1983 [sic]. It was a bit anti-apartheid, and I tried to make it as musical as possible. [Simon's] Gracelands is a great use of African sounds mixed with American songwriting. It's a tremendous album; really excellent.
